betterquesting:10.desc:8:
You arrive with tools, hunger, and a blank map. Before there can be a civilization, there must be one defensible room where useful materials stop being loot and become inventory.

Obtain coal, iron, copper, tin, and rubber.

Industrial growth needs permanent systems, not a collection of machines placed for one recipe. Copper or Iron Storage advances the early survival and workshop program and prepares the systems that follow.

Build either a Copper Chest or an Iron Chest and keep it in your inventory long enough for the questbook to recognize it.

Civilization is built between major breakthroughs as much as at them. Field engineering rewards the tools, remote controls, and recovery practices that keep ambitious systems from becoming fragile ones.

Techguns: Option+Y forces a reload; right-click aims/uses the weapon and left-click fires.

Obtain a basic defensive weapon and ammunition.

A plan begins to matter when it becomes infrastructure that other work can depend on. Manual Production Area advances the early survival and workshop program and prepares the systems that follow.

Arrange crafting, furnaces, storage, and safe lighting as a usable workshop.

The early survival and workshop program is ready for its defining achievement. The workshop is secure. The next chapter asks it to produce power instead of merely consuming daylight.

Maintain a lit, enclosed workshop and prepare the materials for an IC2 Generator.

A hand-fed furnace can process material, but it cannot distribute power. The Generator is the first machine that lets one fuel source support an electrical workshop instead of one isolated task.

Build and fuel an IC2 Generator.

Electricity becomes useful only when it can move safely. LV cable gives the workshop a shared power network, while transformers let later voltage tiers feed smaller machines without destroying them.

IC2 voltage is determined by the largest EU packet a machine receives. Use transformer output faces deliberately, match cables and storage to the intended tier, and step voltage down before a higher-tier source feeds lower-tier equipment; insulation does not make an oversized packet safe.

Connect generation, storage, and machines at safe voltage.

Electric machines turn fuel into a workshop-wide resource. A dependable processing suite replaces separate furnace fires with controllable EU and lays the foundation for continuous production.

Successfully operate a Macerator, Electric Furnace, Extractor, and Compressor.

A machine earns its place when it performs useful work as part of the larger factory. Demonstrated Ore Doubling advances the electrification program and prepares the systems that follow.

Macerate and smelt ore for at least twice the direct-smelting output.

Expansion now depends on securing a tool or material that ordinary workshop methods cannot replace. Electric Tools advances the field engineering program and prepares the systems that follow.

F10 changes supported IC2 tool modes. Backslash is the armor modifier, Option+H toggles boost, and Option+O expands the armor HUD. Sneak while mining or chopping when you need precise one-block behavior.

Pack tool behavior: stone-tier axes and better, plus the IC2 Chainsaw, fell one connected leaf-bearing tree and charge durability/EU per log. The IC2 Drill mines a 3×3 plane and the Diamond Drill a 9×9 plane; Sneak restores one-block precision.

Build and charge basic IC2 electric tools.

IC2 machines care about the size of each incoming EU packet, not only total energy. Safe expansion depends on matching machine tiers, cable losses, storage output, and transformer direction before power is applied.

IC2 voltage is determined by the largest EU packet a machine receives. Use transformer output faces deliberately, match cables and storage to the intended tier, and step voltage down before a higher-tier source feeds lower-tier equipment; insulation does not make an oversized packet safe.

Explain or demonstrate voltage tiers, transformer placement, and insulation.

The electrification program is ready for its defining achievement. Electricity is stable enough to trust. Now the factory must learn to move and process material without constant supervision.

Operate the full processing suite without cable loss or recurring power collapse.

Ore doubling is valuable, but carrying every stack between machines still makes the player the factory's conveyor belt. Routed processing is the first step toward production that continues unattended.

Route raw ore through processing into organized output without hand transfer.

Industrial demand eventually exceeds what even efficient manual mining can supply. A Quarry turns extraction into permanent infrastructure, delivering a steady material stream to the same EU-centered economy that powers the workshop.

Build and run a BuildCraft Quarry.

Automation fails when inputs pile up in one machine and outputs block another. Pipes, hoppers, and buffers give material a route through the factory and make throughput a property of the system rather than the player.

Route Quarry output with BuildCraft pipes, ProjectRed tubes, Logistics Pipes, or rail.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Loaded Industrial Area advances the field engineering program and prepares the systems that follow.

Keep the automated industrial area loaded using an appropriate chunk-loading system.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Remote Factory Control advances the field engineering program and prepares the systems that follow.

Start or stop a production subsystem using wireless redstone.

Repeated recipes are another form of manual labor. Early autocrafting is deliberately physical and modest: ingredients must be routed into a fixed recipe, and the output must have somewhere to go.

Use a fixed-recipe automatic crafting table with physical ingredient routing for a repeated recipe.

The automated industry program is ready for its defining achievement. Automation has created throughput. Heavy industry will decide whether that throughput can survive scale, politics, and attack.

Demonstrate sustained throughput above manual production.

Automation makes the workshop valuable enough to defend and hungry enough to outgrow its walls. Steel, fuel, freight, force fields, and organized security transform a homestead into strategic infrastructure.

Railcraft locomotive: Option+[ reverse, Option+period faster, Option+] slower, Option+; mode, and Option+' whistle. Right-click the locomotive for its configuration screen.

Produce Railcraft steel in a repeatable industrial process.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Oil Refining and Fluid Storage advances the heavy industry program and prepares the systems that follow.

Refine oil and buffer fuel at industrial scale.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Advanced IC2 Processing advances the heavy industry program and prepares the systems that follow.

IC2 voltage is determined by the largest EU packet a machine receives. Use transformer output faces deliberately, match cables and storage to the intended tier, and step voltage down before a higher-tier source feeds lower-tier equipment; insulation does not make an oversized packet safe.

Operate advanced IC2 machines on an appropriately transformed network.

Separate worlds become one civilization only when material can move between them predictably. Cargo logistics turns launches into scheduled infrastructure instead of heroic one-off expeditions.

Railcraft locomotive: Option+[ reverse, Option+period faster, Option+] slower, Option+; mode, and Option+' whistle. Right-click the locomotive for its configuration screen.

Move bulk materials or fuel using rail or an equivalent logistics trunk.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Industrial Armament advances the heavy industry program and prepares the systems that follow.

Techguns: Option+Y forces a reload; right-click aims/uses the weapon and left-click fires.

Manufacture a firearm and ammunition through the factory.

Scale exposes every weak connection, so this stage brings the chapter's systems into one working whole. Human Factions advances the heavy industry program and prepares the systems that follow.

Factions: Pause > Factions & Settlements shows reputation, attitude, membership rules, known settlement types, and trades. Normal right-click opens IC Credit trades; sneak-right-click requests membership. Trusted members at 60 reputation can recruit a companion by holding 8 IC Credits while sneak-right-clicking.

Trade with a friendly settlement, survive a hostile encounter, and approach an ambiguous armed faction.

A plan begins to matter when it becomes infrastructure that other work can depend on. Industrial Containment advances the heavy industry program and prepares the systems that follow.

An MFFS installation needs power, a configured Projector, and a field shape that encloses the area it protects. Test access and shutdown from outside the field before trusting it around valuable machinery.

Build an MFFS defensive, restricted-area, or containment installation.

The real test of mature industry is whether power, materials, logistics, and control remain stable together. Heavy Industrial Complex advances the heavy industry program and prepares the systems that follow.

Sustain steel, refined fuel, advanced processing, powered storage, and bulk logistics.

The heavy industry program is ready for its defining achievement. The installation now has industrial weight. Its next weakness is coordination, not machinery.

Gain heavy industrial capacity by building it or restoring a captured abandoned factory.

Complete the Heavy Industrial Complex construction route OR restore the side-path abandoned factory to safe operation.

A factory large enough to matter is too complex to steer with levers alone. Computers become the nervous system: observing queues, scheduling production, and turning many machines into one coordinated plant.

ComputerCraft: right-click a computer to open it; type help for built-in help; hold Control+T to terminate a running program. Use peripheral.getNames() and peripheral.wrap(side) to find attached machines.

Boot a ComputerCraft computer and save a working factory-control program.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Factory Telemetry advances the programmable manufacturing program and prepares the systems that follow.

ComputerCraft: right-click a computer to open it; type help for built-in help; hold Control+T to terminate a running program. Use peripheral.getNames() and peripheral.wrap(side) to find attached machines.

Monitor energy storage, one machine, and a fuel or fluid tank.

This stage turns the output of earlier industry into a durable capability for the next frontier. Electric Fabricator advances the programmable manufacturing program and prepares the systems that follow.

Industrial Civilization machines: right-click to open the IC2-styled EU/inventory screen. Put recipe inputs in the three left slots and take output from the right slot. Matching inputs run automatically; ComputerCraft is required only for explicit recipe selection, queues, telemetry, or cargo channels.

Power an Electric Fabricator and use it to complete one component recipe.

Fixed automation is efficient until demand changes. The Programmable Assembler turns recipes into selectable production programs, letting one powered line queue different work and report what it still needs.

Industrial Civilization machines: right-click to open the IC2-styled EU/inventory screen. Put recipe inputs in the three left slots and take output from the right slot. Matching inputs run automatically; ComputerCraft is required only for explicit recipe selection, queues, telemetry, or cargo channels.

ComputerCraft: right-click a computer to open it; type help for built-in help; hold Control+T to terminate a running program. Use peripheral.getNames() and peripheral.wrap(side) to find attached machines.

Assembler peripheral: after local m = peripheral.wrap("right"), use m.listRecipes(), m.selectRecipe("control_processor"), and m.queue(4). Replace right with the side where the assembler is attached.

Power a Programmable Assembler, select a recipe, and complete one production order.

A programmable factory should keep working after one order finishes. Queues turn production into a schedule, while shortage reporting shows whether the real bottleneck is material, power, or output space.

ComputerCraft: right-click a computer to open it; type help for built-in help; hold Control+T to terminate a running program. Use peripheral.getNames() and peripheral.wrap(side) to find attached machines.

Assembler peripheral: after local m = peripheral.wrap("right"), use m.listRecipes(), m.selectRecipe("control_processor"), and m.queue(4). Replace right with the side where the assembler is attached.

Queue a production order and report progress and missing ingredients.

Scale exposes every weak connection, so this stage brings the chapter's systems into one working whole. Automated Multi-Step Manufacturing advances the programmable manufacturing program and prepares the systems that follow.

Assembler peripheral: after local m = peripheral.wrap("right"), use m.listRecipes(), m.selectRecipe("control_processor"), and m.queue(4). Replace right with the side where the assembler is attached.

Complete a multi-step product with automatic routing, monitored buffers, and no routine hand-crafting.

Separate machines must now behave as one dependable system rather than isolated successes. Programmable Manufacturing advances the programmable manufacturing program and prepares the systems that follow.

Assembler peripheral: after local m = peripheral.wrap("right"), use m.listRecipes(), m.selectRecipe("control_processor"), and m.queue(4). Replace right with the side where the assembler is attached.

Operate monitored, queued production that can identify shortages and recover from replenishment.

The programmable manufacturing program is ready for its defining achievement. The plant can be programmed and observed. It is ready to take responsibility for nuclear-scale power.

Gain programmable manufacturing by building it or recovering the abandoned factory control system.

Complete the programmable manufacturing route OR restore and audit the captured factory control system.

Orbital construction requires power that does not disappear with daylight or weather. Nuclear energy provides that scale, but only when heat, cooling, containment, and shutdown systems are designed before the reactor is started.

Design the reactor from a tested component layout before inserting fuel. Observe heat and EU output during the first cycle, and wire the reactor chamber to a remote redstone control that can stop the core without requiring a close approach.

Build a complete IC2 nuclear reactor and safe support area.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Sustained Nuclear Output advances the nuclear age program and prepares the systems that follow.

Design the reactor from a tested component layout before inserting fuel. Observe heat and EU output during the first cycle, and wire the reactor chamber to a remote redstone control that can stop the core without requiring a close approach.

Produce useful sustained power with a stable reactor design.

A reactor that appears quiet may still be approaching failure. Continuous heat, output, and operating-state telemetry turns invisible risk into information that automation can act upon.

Design the reactor from a tested component layout before inserting fuel. Observe heat and EU output during the first cycle, and wire the reactor chamber to a remote redstone control that can stop the core without requiring a close approach.

ComputerCraft: right-click a computer to open it; type help for built-in help; hold Control+T to terminate a running program. Use peripheral.getNames() and peripheral.wrap(side) to find attached machines.

Monitor heat, output, and operating state.

Monitoring is useful only if the control system can respond. A remote shutdown must remove the reactor's ability to continue producing heat or power even when the operator cannot safely approach it.

Design the reactor from a tested component layout before inserting fuel. Observe heat and EU output during the first cycle, and wire the reactor chamber to a remote redstone control that can stop the core without requiring a close approach.

Trigger a remote shutdown and watch reactor output fall to zero.

Automation reduces risk; containment limits the consequences when prevention fails. Build the reactor as an industrial facility with controlled access and a deliberate barrier between the core and the rest of the settlement.

An MFFS installation needs power, a configured Projector, and a field shape that encloses the area it protects. Test access and shutdown from outside the field before trusting it around valuable machinery.

Use MFFS or equivalent containment appropriate to the reactor risk.

The nuclear age program is ready for its defining achievement. The reactor can sustain orbital construction. The sky is now a logistics problem rather than a boundary.

Operate stable, monitored high-output nuclear infrastructure for advanced manufacturing.

Earth has taught the settlement everything available at the bottom of one gravity well. The first launch is not a sightseeing trip; it is the construction convoy for a permanent laboratory above the atmosphere.

Galacticraft: right-click a fueled rocket to mount it, Space begins launch, and W/A/S/D steer supported vehicles. Command+I opens the spaceship inventory. Right-click machines/cargo loaders to open them; use the standard Galacticraft wrench on configurable connections.

Build a Tier 1 launch system and safely reach Earth orbit; this alone does not authorize Moon access.

Orbit has sunlight and research potential, but no breathable environment. A real station begins with a sealed volume where oxygen production can be measured at the place people and equipment must actually survive.

A sealed room becomes a proven habitat when its Oxygen Sealer supplies breathable air and a nearby Galacticraft Oxygen Detector reaches its active redstone state. Keep storage and the environment-specific support systems inside the maintained base area.

Establish pressure, oxygen, storage, and safe habitation in orbit.

Orbital sunlight is strong, but every station still crosses darkness. Generation and storage must be designed together so life support, telemetry, and research continue through an eclipse.

Environmental solar: place with an unobstructed sky view and connect an IC2 cable to any face. Right-click once so sustained generation is credited to you.

Install IC2 solar generation and enough stored power to survive an eclipse.

A machine earns its place when it performs useful work as part of the larger factory. Orbital Communications and Telemetry advances the orbital age program and prepares the systems that follow.

ComputerCraft: right-click a computer to open it; type help for built-in help; hold Control+T to terminate a running program. Use peripheral.getNames() and peripheral.wrap(side) to find attached machines.

Bring a ComputerCraft telemetry and communications system online.

Crafting another machine can no longer answer every engineering question. The Research Station turns environmental observations and operating records into artifacts that authorize the next technological era.

Industrial Civilization machines: right-click to open the IC2-styled EU/inventory screen. Put recipe inputs in the three left slots and take output from the right slot. Matching inputs run automatically; ComputerCraft is required only for explicit recipe selection, queues, telemetry, or cargo channels.

Install and power a Research Station aboard the orbital facility.

This stage turns the output of earlier industry into a durable capability for the next frontier. Orbital Experiment Module advances the orbital age program and prepares the systems that follow.

Industrial Civilization machines: right-click to open the IC2-styled EU/inventory screen. Put recipe inputs in the three left slots and take output from the right slot. Matching inputs run automatically; ComputerCraft is required only for explicit recipe selection, queues, telemetry, or cargo channels.

Install and power an Orbital Experiment Module where it can collect orbital observations.

A collection of blocks is not yet a station. Habitation, power, communications, storage, experiments, and safe arrival infrastructure must operate together long enough to show that people can remain in orbit.

Sustain habitation, oxygen, power, storage, telemetry, research equipment, and safe arrival infrastructure.

Reaching orbit proves only that the rocket worked. Keeping experiments powered, supplied, and repeatable turns the station into a place that can produce knowledge unavailable on Earth.

Complete the vacuum-materials, radiation, telescope, microgravity, life-support, communications, and eclipse experiments available at the Research Station.

The real test of mature industry is whether power, materials, logistics, and control remain stable together. Orbital Operational Data advances the orbital research program and prepares the systems that follow.

Record station, oxygen, power, solar, eclipse, manufacturing, and transmission uptime.

A station that merely survives is still dependent on Earth. Orbital power engineering exploits constant sunlight and active tracking to make the platform an industrial contributor.

Environmental solar: place with an unobstructed sky view and connect an IC2 cable to any face. Right-click once so sustained generation is credited to you.

Run an automated orbital production line from enhanced orbital solar generation.

The orbital power program is ready for its defining achievement. Orbital generation can now carry real production loads and support later off-world industry.

Environmental solar: place with an unobstructed sky view and connect an IC2 cable to any face. Right-click once so sustained generation is credited to you.

Build an advanced tracking array and operate it in orbit, where active tracking can deliver 15–25× its Earth output.

Expansion now depends on securing a tool or material that ordinary workshop methods cannot replace. Orbital Research Archive advances the orbital research program and prepares the systems that follow.

When a finished research artifact is meant to open new work, hold it and right-click once to register the knowledge it contains.

Complete the orbital research program and assemble its results into an Orbital Research Archive.

The orbital research program is ready for its defining achievement. The orbital archive is complete. Lunar settlement is now a researched commitment, not a gamble.

When a finished research artifact is meant to open new work, hold it and right-click once to register the knowledge it contains.

Use the Orbital Research Archive to authorize lunar navigation, descent, and environmental systems.

The orbital archive points toward the Moon, but flags do not make settlements. A real lunar foothold must breathe, generate power, mine locally, manufacture replacements, and send cargo without depending on a rescue flight.

Galacticraft: right-click a fueled rocket to mount it, Space begins launch, and W/A/S/D steer supported vehicles. Command+I opens the spaceship inventory. Right-click machines/cargo loaders to open them; use the standard Galacticraft wrench on configurable connections.

Land on the Moon only after Orbital Research completion.

Industrial growth needs permanent systems, not a collection of machines placed for one recipe. Lunar Habitat advances the lunar settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

A sealed room becomes a proven habitat when its Oxygen Sealer supplies breathable air and a nearby Galacticraft Oxygen Detector reaches its active redstone state. Keep storage and the environment-specific support systems inside the maintained base area.

Establish pressure, oxygen, thermal control, communications, and safe habitation.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Lunar Power Through Darkness advances the lunar settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

Environmental solar: place with an unobstructed sky view and connect an IC2 cable to any face. Right-click once so sustained generation is credited to you.

Provide generation and storage capable of maintaining the base through a lunar darkness cycle.

The Moon becomes useful when it can supply its own industry. Automated mining reduces dependence on launch mass and begins converting an expedition into an extraterrestrial settlement.

Extract lunar resources automatically and deliver them to local processing.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Local Lunar Manufacturing advances the lunar settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

Process lunar materials and manufacture a useful spacecraft or precision component locally.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Lunar Cargo Return advances the cargo logistics program and prepares the systems that follow.

Galacticraft: right-click a fueled rocket to mount it, Space begins launch, and W/A/S/D steer supported vehicles. Command+I opens the spaceship inventory. Right-click machines/cargo loaders to open them; use the standard Galacticraft wrench on configurable connections.

Return cargo or establish an automated Earth-orbit-Moon supply route.

The lunar settlement program is ready for its defining achievement. The Moon can support industry. Its environment can now be used as an instrument of science.

Sustain habitation, local power, mining, processing, manufacturing, research readiness, and communications.

The Moon's long darkness and unfamiliar materials expose the limits of terrestrial engineering. Sustained lunar science now becomes the bridge to extreme voltage and quantum machinery.

Complete the regolith, metallurgy, radiation, seismic, isotope, habitat, mining, communications, and precision-manufacturing studies available at the lunar base.

Lunar night lasts far longer than an Earth night. Surviving one complete darkness cycle requires stored energy, disciplined loads, and enough local infrastructure to avoid turning every eclipse into an evacuation.

Maintain habitation and industry through a full lunar darkness challenge.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Lunar Precision Manufacturing advances the lunar research program and prepares the systems that follow.

Manufacture a precision component locally and transmit production telemetry.

The right component can carry the knowledge and capacity of an entire production chain. Lunar Engineering Archive advances the lunar research program and prepares the systems that follow.

When a finished research artifact is meant to open new work, hold it and right-click once to register the knowledge it contains.

Complete the lunar research program and assemble its results into a Lunar Engineering Archive.

The lunar research program is ready for its defining achievement. Lunar knowledge has opened the quantum route. Mars remains locked until that route becomes dependable industry.

When a finished research artifact is meant to open new work, hold it and right-click once to register the knowledge it contains.

Use the Lunar Engineering Archive to open Quantum Technology research; Mars remains locked.

Quantum manufacturing needs energy at a scale ordinary workshops cannot deliver. EV systems demand deliberate transformers, tier-appropriate machines, and packet safety; a single oversized packet can destroy equipment regardless of the average EU/t.

IC2 voltage is determined by the largest EU packet a machine receives. Use transformer output faces deliberately, match cables and storage to the intended tier, and step voltage down before a higher-tier source feeds lower-tier equipment; insulation does not make an oversized packet safe.

Operate high-tier generation, storage, transformation, and advanced processing safely.

Expansion now depends on securing a tool or material that ordinary workshop methods cannot replace. Robotic Manufacturing Cell advances the quantum technology program and prepares the systems that follow.

Industrial Civilization machines: right-click to open the IC2-styled EU/inventory screen. Put recipe inputs in the three left slots and take output from the right slot. Matching inputs run automatically; ComputerCraft is required only for explicit recipe selection, queues, telemetry, or cargo channels.

Power a Robotic Manufacturing Cell and complete one local automated production cycle.

This stage turns the output of earlier industry into a durable capability for the next frontier. Lunar Quantum Component advances the quantum technology program and prepares the systems that follow.

Manufacture a Lunar Quantum Component using the precision industry established on the Moon.

The right component can carry the knowledge and capacity of an entire production chain. NanoSuit and Powered Tools advances the quantum technology program and prepares the systems that follow.

F10 changes supported IC2 tool modes. Backslash is the armor modifier, Option+H toggles boost, and Option+O expands the armor HUD. Sneak while mining or chopping when you need precise one-block behavior.

Manufacture NanoSuit equipment and advanced charged tools.

The real test of mature industry is whether power, materials, logistics, and control remain stable together. Complete Charged QuantumSuit advances the quantum technology program and prepares the systems that follow.

F10 changes supported IC2 tool modes. Backslash is the armor modifier, Option+H toggles boost, and Option+O expands the armor HUD. Sneak while mining or chopping when you need precise one-block behavior.

Manufacture a complete QuantumSuit and demonstrate sufficient infrastructure to charge it.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Mars Readiness Trial advances the quantum technology program and prepares the systems that follow.

Demonstrate thermal, radiation, power, life-support compatibility, and automated spare-part production.

Separate machines must now behave as one dependable system rather than isolated successes. Quantum Technology Complete advances the quantum technology program and prepares the systems that follow.

Master conventional high-tier technology and Mars-ready automated manufacturing.

An MFSU stores enormous energy, but its most important property here is a legal 512-EU output packet. Establish one safe packet as the baseline before attempting parallel burst power.

Complete a genuine energy-limited manufacturing operation while it receives at least one legal 512-EU MFSU-class packet in a tick.

MFSU bank: orient each MFSU output toward an independent EnergyNet connection to the same tier-3-compatible machine. Start the real recipe before discharge. The machine GUI reports aggregate Input EU/t and speed; an adjacent ComputerCraft computer can also call getMfsuPacketsThisTick() and getOperationPeakMfsuPackets().

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Connect a real MFSU to a tier-3-compatible Industrial Civilization manufacturing machine.
- Start a genuine recipe and complete it under live IC2 EnergyNet power.
- Run the operation with at least one 512-EU packet reaching the machine.

Voltage and throughput are different quantities. Four MFSUs can deliver four legal 512-EU packets in the same tick—2,048 EU/t in aggregate—without ever exposing the machine to a packet above its tier.

Complete genuine manufacturing after delivering four legal MFSU-class packets in one tick for at least 2,048 EU/t of burst input.

MFSU bank: orient each MFSU output toward an independent EnergyNet connection to the same tier-3-compatible machine. Start the real recipe before discharge. The machine GUI reports aggregate Input EU/t and speed; an adjacent ComputerCraft computer can also call getMfsuPacketsThisTick() and getOperationPeakMfsuPackets().

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Build four independently connected and correctly oriented MFSUs.
- Complete a real recipe with a peak of at least four 512-EU packets in one tick.
- Complete the operation at higher aggregate throughput without exceeding the voltage of any individual packet.

Parallel storage turns electrical architecture into manufacturing speed. Ten independently connected MFSUs can deliver 5,120 EU/t as ten legal packets when the receiving machine can convert extra accepted EU into work.

Complete genuine manufacturing after delivering ten legal MFSU-class packets in one tick for at least 5,120 EU/t of burst input.

MFSU bank: orient each MFSU output toward an independent EnergyNet connection to the same tier-3-compatible machine. Start the real recipe before discharge. The machine GUI reports aggregate Input EU/t and speed; an adjacent ComputerCraft computer can also call getMfsuPacketsThisTick() and getOperationPeakMfsuPackets().

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Scale the parallel bank to ten real MFSUs without combining them into one illegal packet.
- Complete a real recipe with a peak of at least ten 512-EU packets in one tick.
- Observe the expected throughput increase through the machine GUI or ComputerCraft telemetry.

At fifty parallel MFSUs, the bank can deliver 25,600 EU/t while every packet remains 512 EU. This is fundamentally different from one illegal 25,600-EU packet and is intentional expert IC2 engineering.

Complete genuine manufacturing with a physical fifty-MFSU bank delivering at least 25,600 EU/t as fifty independently legal packets.

MFSU bank: orient each MFSU output toward an independent EnergyNet connection to the same tier-3-compatible machine. Start the real recipe before discharge. The machine GUI reports aggregate Input EU/t and speed; an adjacent ComputerCraft computer can also call getMfsuPacketsThisTick() and getOperationPeakMfsuPackets().

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Charge, orient, and connect fifty real MFSUs to a tier-3-compatible machine.
- Complete a real recipe with a peak of at least fifty 512-EU packets in one tick.
- Use the fifty-unit bank to accelerate real work while every individual packet remains within the machine's voltage limit.

A mature burst-power bank can compress an energy-limited manufacturing cycle into a fraction of a second. The challenge is to achieve that speed through real concurrent packets, not stored progress or a finished item supplied in advance.

Use a fifty-MFSU burst bank to finish a genuine energy-limited first-party manufacturing recipe in eight active ticks or fewer—less than 0.4 seconds.

MFSU bank: orient each MFSU output toward an independent EnergyNet connection to the same tier-3-compatible machine. Start the real recipe before discharge. The machine GUI reports aggregate Input EU/t and speed; an adjacent ComputerCraft computer can also call getMfsuPacketsThisTick() and getOperationPeakMfsuPackets().

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Use a Robotic Manufacturing Cell or another compatible energy-limited first-party machine.
- Deliver at least fifty MFSU-class packets in one operation tick.
- Complete the genuine recipe in no more than eight active ticks; precharging or possessing the output does not count.

The quantum technology program is ready for its defining achievement. Quantum industry closes the distance to Mars. The next launch carries the seed of an autonomous colony.

When a finished research artifact is meant to open new work, hold it and right-click once to register the knowledge it contains.

Combine the required Quantum, lunar, and readiness work into a Mars Mission Authorization.

Mars is not the next sightseeing destination. Its distance makes rescue and resupply unreliable, so the mission begins only after lunar engineering and Quantum technology can support a colony designed to stand on its own.

Galacticraft: right-click a fueled rocket to mount it, Space begins launch, and W/A/S/D steer supported vehicles. Command+I opens the spaceship inventory. Right-click machines/cargo loaders to open them; use the standard Galacticraft wrench on configurable connections.

Build a Tier 2 spacecraft and travel to Mars with mission authorization.

Industrial growth needs permanent systems, not a collection of machines placed for one recipe. Martian Habitat advances the mars settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

A sealed room becomes a proven habitat when its Oxygen Sealer supplies breathable air and a nearby Galacticraft Oxygen Detector reaches its active redstone state. Keep storage and the environment-specific support systems inside the maintained base area.

Establish pressure, oxygen, water, radiation protection, communications, and safe habitation.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Reliable Martian Power advances the mars settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

Environmental solar: place with an unobstructed sky view and connect an IC2 cable to any face. Right-click once so sustained generation is credited to you.

Maintain local generation and storage through dust-related solar fluctuation; nuclear backup is encouraged.

A machine earns its place when it performs useful work as part of the larger factory. Automated Martian Mining advances the mars settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

Mine and route Martian resources without direct labor.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Local Martian Manufacturing advances the mars settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

Process Martian materials and manufacture colony components locally.

This stage turns the output of earlier industry into a durable capability for the next frontier. Martian Desh Sample advances the mars settlement program and prepares the systems that follow.

Obtain Galacticraft Desh (metadata 2), the existing real Mars Sample used by the Molecular Analyzer.

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Install a Plant Sower, Plant Gatherer, and Resourceful Furnace as one working tree-farm line.
- Configure the Gatherer's working area to cover the Sower's tree plot and route saplings back to planting.
- Smelt harvested logs into charcoal and feed the charcoal to an IC2 Generator while retaining surplus wood.

The next bottleneck is practical throughput rather than access to another recipe. Automated Field Agriculture advances the side path — automated agriculture program and prepares the systems that follow.

Add a Plant Interactor and Plant Fertilizer for crops that should be harvested without breaking their planted state. Keep fertilizer inputs renewable and constrain the working area to avoid neighboring breeding plots.

Industrial Foregoing agriculture: right-click the machine to configure its working area, item or fluid inputs, and output handling. Supply it from IC2 generation through the installed adapter; one LV line has ample capacity for these farm machines.

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Craft both the Plant Interactor and Plant Fertilizer from IC2 LV components.
- Set their working areas over a field-crop plot rather than the tree plot.
- Verify harvested output enters storage and the planted crop remains available for another growth cycle.

A renewable herd still needs population control. Automated breeding, growth, and separation keep adults productive without overcrowding the enclosure or consuming every food reserve.

Use the Animal Breeder, Animal Growth Increaser, and Animal Baby Separator to turn the controlled livestock enclosure into a renewable, population-limited husbandry system.

Industrial Foregoing agriculture: right-click the machine to configure its working area, item or fluid inputs, and output handling. Supply it from IC2 generation through the installed adapter; one LV line has ample capacity for these farm machines.

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Install the Animal Breeder, Growth Increaser, and Baby Separator around the same livestock enclosure.
- Supply species-appropriate food and set a breeding population limit before unattended operation.
- Route juveniles away from the breeding enclosure so the adult population remains controlled.

Installed equipment is only potential; reliable operation is what expands the civilization's capacity. Automated Animal Resources advances the side path — automated agriculture program and prepares the systems that follow.

Harvest renewable products from living animals, collect sewage, and compost it into fertilizer. This peaceful production line does not introduce hostile-mob drops or require a slaughter factory.

Industrial Foregoing agriculture: right-click the machine to configure its working area, item or fluid inputs, and output handling. Supply it from IC2 generation through the installed adapter; one LV line has ample capacity for these farm machines.

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Own the Animal Resource Harvester, Animal Byproduct Collector, and Sewage Composter together.
- Collect milk or wool without killing the breeding population.
- Pipe collected sewage into the composter and store the resulting fertilizer for the crop line.

The side path — automated agriculture program is ready for its defining achievement. Peaceful agriculture is now automated from soil to storage, and its charcoal loop can finance the settlement's next generation of electrical machines.

Round out peaceful LV agriculture with the Water Resources Collector, giving the settlement an automated fishing and aquatic-resource station without creating a hostile-mob economy.

Industrial Foregoing agriculture: right-click the machine to configure its working area, item or fluid inputs, and output handling. Supply it from IC2 generation through the installed adapter; one LV line has ample capacity for these farm machines.

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Craft and place a Water Resources Collector from its IC2 LV recipe.
- Give it a valid water working area and connect output storage.
- Operate tree, field-crop, livestock-product, fertilizer, and water-resource lines as one complete agricultural district.

A Quarry can automate excavation, but reaching bedrock still leaves the next worksite to the engineer. This optional challenge turns relocation into physical infrastructure: ProjectRed machinery must recover the exhausted Quarry, carry its control and logistics harness to the next lane, and deploy the same machine again without teleportation or a hidden spare.

Build a non-teleporting ProjectRed frame carriage that recovers one exhausted BuildCraft Quarry, advances one lane, redeploys that same Quarry, and resumes extraction.

Bring the project online in these stages:
- Mount the Mobile Quarry Controller, ProjectRed Block Breaker and Block Placer, redstone bus, Quarry recovery path, and output route on one connected frame carriage.
- Leave the Block Placer empty before the run so the broken Quarry itself must travel through the recovery path.
- Keep both lanes loaded with one fixed, fueled Standard Worldspike; do not use teleport pipes, teleport tethers, or a spare Quarry.
- Run the first Quarry to bedrock and let the controller command all 16 verified frame steps without manual pulses.
- Confirm that the recovered Quarry is placed at the next lane and resumes frame construction and excavation.
